src: tools/blender/trees (build_trees.py: treegen.py geometry, textures.py maps; check_promises.py, check_hollows.py; publish.py: the upload). Procedural Blender only.
units: studs, Roblox axes (+Y up). pivot = the tree's root on the ground (data/harvest/trees.json root x 2.5).
placement: model = InsertService:LoadAsset(assetId):GetChildren()[1]; its pivot is the FBX origin = the tree root, so model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pivot)) puts every MeshPart at pivot + parts[name].center, unrotated. Server/Assets/TreeArt swaps the baked tree's meshes for these (visual only: the baked proxies keep colliding). The trunk carries 3 studs of bark below the pivot.

partRoles.Bark: trunk, roots, boughs, bridges, side branches and twigs: one skin, the climbing surfaces (visual only in the game: the baked proxies collide)
partRoles.LeavesShade: leaf sprays under the canopy (alpha cards: DoubleSided, AlphaMode Transparency)
partRoles.LeavesMid: leaf sprays in half light (alpha cards)
partRoles.LeavesSun: leaf sprays that see the sky (alpha cards)
